translations.web: Yahweh will make the rain of your land powder and dust. It will come down on you from the sky, until you are destroyed.
translations.bsb: The LORD will turn the rain of your land into dust and powder; it will descend on you from the sky until you are destroyed.
translations.kjv: The LORD shall make the rain of thy land powder and dust: from heaven shall it come down upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
translations.asv: Jehovah will make the rain of thy land powder and dust: from heaven shall it come down upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
